entries.label: R-A1 household mirror seed 101 v4 (matched visible appearance cue)
entries.public_goal: Inspect the salt shaker appearance inside the red outline in the initial head-camera view. Report ANSWER: reflected or ANSWER: direct before grasping a candidate. Deliver the corresponding real salt shaker to blue if the appearance is reflected, or to yellow if it is direct.

public.objective: Inspect the salt shaker appearance inside the red outline in the initial head-camera view. Report ANSWER: reflected or ANSWER: direct before grasping a candidate. Deliver the corresponding real salt shaker to blue if the appearance is reflected, or to yellow if it is direct.
public.success_criteria: Report whether the initial framed appearance is reflected or direct before the first candidate grasp, and deliver the corresponding real salt shaker to the declared color. Use a genuine robot grasp to lift each required salt shaker at least 5 cm. Leave all required salt shakers supported and released without robot contact for at least 0.5 seconds, with linear speed at most 0.02 m/s and angular speed at most 0.1 rad/s. Leave the working hand empty and open, withdraw the robot hands from the salt shakers, and declare DONE.
public.environment: A furnished meeting room with salt shakers on a fixed deck over an existing native table, a physical mirror, a red rectangular outline, blue and yellow delivery pads, and a fixed yellow reference pillar.
constraints: Keep the table, pads, mirror, red outline and yellow reference pillar fixed; preserve all object dimensions.
Use the existing guarded public controls and robot-mounted observations.
Interpret the requested appearance using the initial head-camera view. Later robot movement does not redefine the requested real salt shaker.
The first candidate grasp commits the real-object selection. Do not grasp a different candidate.
Keep each unselected salt shaker within 2 cm of its starting position.

geometry_proposal.scope: Saved static collision bounds, bounding-center height and approximate head eye; actual native collision centroid, projection, support and optics must qualify.

revision_evidence.finding: R-A2 V3 uniquely selects a direct object geometrically, but native head image clips the outer target and red cue. Geometric selection alone is insufficient for image acceptance.
revision_evidence.change: Use candidate Y offsets -0.32, 0, 0.32 m in both matched appearance conditions and recompute cue geometry. Preserve all counts, assets, furniture, goals, seeds, scoring and budgets.
revision_evidence.projection: All four cue rods fit with an 8-pixel margin under the previous measured native camera. This is a static projection proposal; fresh native image review remains required.
